products.title: Wildlife Restoration Complex — Concept Master Plan
products.body_html:
Client:
National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC) — Environmental Restoration Program
Location:
Hafr Al‑Batin Governorate, Eastern Province (300,000 m² / 71.5 acres)
Project Area:
Environmental Master Planning & Design
Year: 2026
Project status:
In Progress — Concept Master Plan Phase
Project Sector
Design / Studies / Environmental Restoration


As Prime Consultant, FCEC developed the Concept Master Plan for the Wildlife Restoration Complex under the Environmental Restoration Program of the National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC). Set on a 300,000 m² (71.5‑acre) site in Hafr Al‑Batin Governorate in the Eastern Province, the master plan organizes the complex into integrated functional zones — the Badiyah Nature Center (BNC), the Desert Garden (DG), the Terrestrial Applied Research Center (TARC), and the Experimental Fields — linked by a hierarchy of road, pedestrian, and green‑corridor networks and served by dedicated visitor, researcher, and operations entrances, with reserved areas for future development. Combining ecological restoration with scientific research and community engagement, the plan is designed to rehabilitate degraded terrestrial ecosystems, strengthen native plant and animal habitats, and establish the complex as a regional model for long‑term environmental sustainability in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

•    Preparing accounting entries, recording financial transactions in the records, auditing bank accounts and preparing the necessary settlements with monthly matching statements.

•    Developing accounting methods and procedures and keeping pace with scientific and technical developments in the field of accounting.

•    Preparing specialized documents and reports in the field of accounting for expenses and revenues and storing them in the database for that purpose.

  • Accuracy, attention to detail, and data analysis skills.

products.title: Transport and Traffic Safety Engineer
products.body_html:
Job Brief

A Traffic Safety Engineer is committed to obtaining safety goals through continuous improvement of transportation planning, design, operations, and safety investment strategies. Traffic Safety Engineers utilize multiple strategies to integrate safety data and analysis into transportation decision-making processes.

مهندس نقل وسلامة مرورية

مهندس السلامة المرورية ملتزم بتحقيق أهداف السلامة من خلال التحسين المستمر لتخطيط النقل وتصميمه وعملياته واستراتيجيات الاستثمار في السلامة. يستخدم مهندسو السلامة المرورية استراتيجيات متعددة لدمج بيانات السلامة والتحليل في عمليات اتخاذ القرارات المتعلقة بالنقل.

Responsibilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering with at least 8 years of experience in the field of transport and traffic safety.
  • Full proficiency in road design, preparation of plans, and working with AutoCAD CIVIL 3D.
  • Proficiency in traffic analysis and modeling using computer tools and software.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the equipment and tools used on roads and required traffic safety measures.
  • Study and assist in developing traffic safety conditions on roads.
  • Review proposed requests for road traffic diversions submitted by contractors and evaluate the situation of diversions during ongoing works.
  • Review proposed requests for road traffic diversions submitted by contractors and evaluate the situation of diversions during ongoing works.
  • Evaluate hazardous work environments to apply rules and procedures.
  • Prepare periodic reports on contractors’ performance, highlighting points that need adjustment for safety.
  • Proficiency in engineering programs (NEMA, MUTCD, AASHTO). .
  • Holder of a course in Road Foundations and Safety. .

المهام الرئيسية

  • بكالوريوس فيبكالوريوس هندسة مدنية لدية خبرة لا تقل عن (8 سنوات) في مجال النقل والسلامة المرورية.
  • اجادة تامة لتصميم الطرق وإعداد المخططات والعمل على برامج ال AutoCAD CIVIL 3D
  • اجادة التحليل المروري ونمذجته باستخدام الأدوات والبرامج الحاسوبية
  • دراية تامة بالأجهزة والمعدات المستخدمة بالطرق ووسائل السلامة المرورية المطلوبة
  • دراسة حالة السلامة المرورية على الطرق والمساعدة في تطويرها.
  • مراجعة الطلبات المقترحة لأعمال التحويلات المرورية للطرق المقدمة من قبل المقاولين وتقييم وضع التحويلات على الطرق أثناء سير الأعمال.
  • تقييم بيئة العمل الخطيرة لغرض تطبيق القواعد والإجراءات
  • عمل التقارير الدورية حول أداء المقاولين وإيضاح النقاط الواجب والمطلوب تعديلها من أجل السلامة
  • اجادة للبرامج الهندسية (NEMA. • MUTCD. • AASHTO)
  • حاصل على دورة أسس وسلامة الطرق.

Educational qualification:

  • Bachelor's

Educational field:

  • Health and Safety, Environmental control, Traffic Safety

Experience:

  • 8 years.

products.title: Civil Engineer
products.body_html:
Job Brief

An experienced Civil Engineer with extensive experience in Roads Supervision projects. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in road supervision, with a strong technical background in road design, construction methodologies, and infrastructure development.

مهندس مدني

مهندس مدني ذو خبرة واسعة في مشاريع الإشراف على الطرق. يجب أن يكون المرشح المثالي لديه خبرة كبيرة في الإشراف على مشاريع تنفيذ الطرق، مع خلفية تقنية قوية في تصميم الطرق، وطرق البناء، وتطوير البنية التحتية.

Responsibilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering with at least 8 years of experience in road construction and maintenance projects.
  • At least 3 years of experience in supervising project execution in Saudi Arabia, with a required certificate of experience to prove it.
  • Experience in road maintenance works, studying and evaluating roads, identifying pavement defects, and proposing appropriate treatments.
  • Must be fully proficient in working with AutoCAD CIVIL 3D and experienced in preparing necessary engineering plans and designs for roads.
  • Thorough knowledge of analyzing soil test results, materials used in road works, necessary tests, and selecting the most suitable materials for pavement layers, designing pavement layers, and determining their components and thicknesses and developments, and consulting them on various important future issues and initiatives.

products.title: GIS Developer
products.body_html:

products.title: Surveyor

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.

products.title: REENGINEERING AND DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION
products.body_html:
Reengineering: One of the business management strategies that is based on the analysis and design of workflow mechanisms and processes in the organization and its basis is to inquire about the added value provided by each step in the process and to remove those steps that do not provide added value.

Reengineering is the basis for many important administrative concepts, including business process re-engineering, continuous improvement of procedures and processes, process automation, electronic services, knowledge management and institutional performance measurement.

The process of re-engineering government services procedures provides an opportunity for the higher government administration to consider its services and determine their usefulness and effectiveness, and if it can be carried out in a less costly manner within the conditions of citizen comfort. Our service in this regard covers the following:

  • Digital transformation solutions in the documentation sector.
  • Digital transformation solutions in the licenses and permits sector.
  • Preparing mechanisms to monitor performance measurement indicators for managers, including time, cost, quality and risk.
  • Study the current status of work and procedures, analyze gaps and identify areas for improvement.
  • Digital transformation solutions in smart applications.

products.title: HYDROLOGICAL STUDIES AND FLOOD RISK ASSESSMENT
products.body_html:
The hydrological study and the assessment of flood risks consist of metrological studies, analysis of morphological rain data, hydrological modeling and hydraulic calculations for the study area in order to extract the paths of the valleys and drainage basins affecting the study areas, and to check the paths of valleys and reefs deduced from the analysis of the digital elevation model with the inferred paths within the field cadastral so that the basins are determined Drainage affecting the study area and determining the exit point of each basin in proportion to the study area to reach the protection works from the dangers of torrential rains (open channels, box channels, ferries, storage basins). hydrological study and the assessment of flood risks consist cover the following:

  • Metrological study and analysis of rainfall data.
  • Modeling of water bodies and simulation of the flood hypothesis.
  • Extracting morphological data for wadis drainage basins affecting the study area.
  • Accurate surveying of valleys, reefs and water courses affecting the study area.
  • The use of various hydraulic calculation programs in the hydraulic design work, in order to protect against the dangers of flooding (open channels, box channels, ferries, storage basins).
  • Compiling the surface geology maps of the study area, the surrounding places, and the drainage basins affecting the study area.

  • SDGPS and RTK mobile GPS scanning.
  • Drone technology.

  • Geographical information systems (GIS), its databases, data and smart applications.
